descriptionChirho: Of liquids flowing or gushing, especially in the formula 'a land flowing with milk and honey'; also of water gushing from a rock.
Substantivized participle (the zav) denoting a person suffering from an abnormal bodily emission, primarily in Levitical purity laws.
Nominal use of the root with possessive suffix referring to a bodily discharge itself, especially menstrual or other genital flow.
Figurative extension meaning to melt away, waste, or pine, as of the wounded or dying whose life ebbs away.
